articles.title: Ned Davis Distills Political Angst Into ‘Big MAC’ Equity Trade
articles.mainIdea: Ned Davis Distills Political Angst Into ‘Big MAC’ Equity Trade
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Ned Davis Distills Political Angst Into ‘Big MAC’ Equity Trade. Now Ed Clissold wants to coin a new moniker. The chief US strategist at Ned Davis Research is aiming to capture what he thinks will be the main theme of 2026: the policy implications in the runup to and fallout from this fall’s Congressional vote. President Donald Trump’s flurry of quasi-policy proclamations to start the year — fired off mostly on social media, with virtually zero legislative clout behind them — reveal his focus on improving the Republican party’s political fortunes in November.
